edge_case: positive events exactly at cutoff timestamp
handling: Included in observation/pre-cutoff data; excluded from outcome because outcome starts strictly after cutoff.

edge_case: customers with positive purchases on both sides of cutoff
handling: Eligibility uses pre-cutoff events; future purchases determine outcome only.

edge_case: eligible customers with multiple positive outcome purchases
handling: Retained as an outcome-count audit; Churn remains 0 for any positive outcome purchase.

edge_case: eligible customers with cancellation activity but no positive outcome purchase
handling: Cancellations do not count as positive outcomes and do not reverse Churn=1.

edge_case: eligible customers with positive purchase at final observed timestamp
handling: Included because outcome end is closed.

edge_case: eligible customers with positive purchase on final observed date
handling: Included because the final observed date is within the supported outcome horizon.

edge_case: duplicate Customer ID rows in final outcome table
handling: Must be zero duplicates; exactly one row per eligible customer.
